question: The sides of a triangle are 105 cm, 137 cm, and 88 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use Heron’s formula

s = (105 + 137 + 88)/2 = 165

Area = √[165 × 60 × 28 × 77]

= √[(3×5×11)(2×2×3×5)(4×7)(7×11)] = √[(2⁴×3²×5²×7²×11²)]

= 2²×3×5×7×11 = 4620

**∴ Answer = 4620**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides = 105 cm, 137 cm, 88 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

 
 105 88 137 

 

Calculation:

⇒ s = (105 + 137 + 88)/2 = 165

⇒ s−a = 60, s−b = 28, s−c = 77

⇒ Area = √(165 × 60 × 28 × 77)

⇒ = √(53361000)

⇒ = 4620 cm2

∴ The correct answer is 4620 cm2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron’s Formula

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

Semi-perimeter

s = (a + b + c)/2

Usage

Used when all three sides are given.
